CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(*) AS donation_count
    FROM
        "donations"
    GROUP BY
        "Donor"
),
repeat_givers AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor"
    FROM
        donor_counts
    WHERE
        donation_count > 1
),
one_time_givers AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor"
    FROM
        donor_counts
    WHERE
        donation_count = 1
),
repeat_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(d."Amount") AS total_repeat_amount
    FROM
        "donations" d
    INNER JOIN
        repeat_givers rg ON d."Donor" = rg."Donor"
),
one_time_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(d."Amount") AS total_one_time_amount
    FROM
        "donations" d
    INNER JOIN
        one_time_givers otg ON d."Donor" = otg."Donor"
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ra.total_repeat_amount, 0) AS repeat_amount,
        COALESCE(ota.total_one_time_amount, 0) AS one_time_amount,
        COALESCE(ra.total_repeat_amount, 0) + COALESCE(ota.total_one_time_amount, 0) AS total_amount
    FROM
        repeat_amounts ra,
        one_time_amounts ota
),
repeat_giver_count AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS repeat_giver_count
    FROM
        repeat_givers
)
SELECT
    (t.repeat_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_amount, 0)) AS share_of_money_from_repeat_givers_percent,
    rgc.repeat_giver_count
FROM
    totals t,
    repeat_giver_count rgc;
